trigger_benchmark.retry_policy: at most one bounded retry per failed (query_id, attempt) pair; one query may have multiple retries only when multiple n-run attempts failed independently; a raised retry timeout must be recorded as retry_timeout_seconds, and first-pass and retry grades must be retained separately
trigger_benchmark.standard_note: runs_per_query 3 is the bounded-recovery routing standard: a single run cannot separate a real routing decision from wall-clock noise. Current acceptance requires every final attempt to pass after the declared bounded retry. First-pass stability is reported independently and requires perfect semantic routing among completed attempts plus no more than 10% runtime errors. A run below n=3 must carry statistical_caveat naming the shortfall.
